entry.title: Disciple Half Corona — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, bourbon, cola (projected)
Occasion: Quick dark-profile smoke, after a meal, outdoor break
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, black pepper, earth, cocoa and cedar with a caramel/toffee sweetness are the strongest recurring notes across independent reviews of this exact Half Corona. The Mexican San Andrés wrapper and all-Nicaraguan core point to a darker, more forceful profile than Rocky Patel's smoother vintage-style blends, while multiple reviews praise its open draw, clean burn and unusually complete progression for a 3½″ cigar. It remains untasted in this catalogue, so Strength 8 and Quality 8 are projections rather than palate-confirmed scores.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted projection. Cigar Aficionado scored the Half Corona 88 points in repeated tastings; independent reviews consistently report strong coffee/pepper character and reliable construction.
productionLines: Mexican San Andrés maduro wrapper; Nicaraguan binder and filler.

note: Ranked at No. 11: stronger projected flavour fit and construction than the currently lower-ranked AJ Fernandez New World Oscuro/Oliva Serie O tier, but held outside the top 10 by the 3.5-inch Bronze Size and high A$31 single-stick price. The Index single was explicitly available at A$31 on 2026-08-31; Cigar Hut listed A$26–A$449 but stock for the single was not independently confirmed.
